verdict: AMD Helios launched with MSFT anchor, Alphabet capex raised to $195-205B — but Morgan Stanley HBM peak note triggered KOSPI circuit-breaker; SK Hynix Q2 (Jul 28) and MSFT/AMZN/META capex guides (Jul 29-30) are the week-defining data points.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (last 24–72h)

**Sig 1 — DRAM pricing decelerating.** Q3 TrendForce forecast: +13–18% QoQ (vs Q2 +58–63%, Q1 +90–95%). Consumer affordability ceiling; server still undersupplied. SK Hynix Q2 **reports July 28** — consensus $43.7B op profit, record 75–77% margin.

**Sig 2 — HBM correction risk: most important signal.** Morgan Stanley (July 21) warned DRAM/HBM prices could peak Q4 2026. KOSPI circuit-breaker July 24: SK Hynix –8%+, Samsung –8%+ (SK Hynix worst Seoul session on record). Simultaneously, NVIDIA + SK Group announced **$500B+ AI initiative** (July 24): 2GW datacenter on Vera Rubin + HBM4. Multi-year contracts insulate near-term demand; correction risk is a 2027 story.

**Sig 3 — Hyperscaler capex: guides UP only.** Alphabet raised full-year capex to **$195–205B** (July 22, +$15B lift); Google Cloud +82% YoY, backlog +$50B to $514B. GOOGL fell –6% anyway on ROI concern. MSFT, AMZN, META all **report July 29–30** — next capex prints still pending.

**Sig 4 — AMD MI400/Helios launched.** AMD Advancing AI 2026 (July 22–23): Helios rack at $5.25M/rack, 72× MI455X + EPYC Venice, 30% better inference $/token vs. NVIDIA claimed. **Microsoft Azure** flagship customer; OpenAI + Meta 12GW commitments. First shipments end Q3, ramp H1 2027. NVIDIA Vera Rubin confirmed in full production (Q3 shipments beginning).

**Sig 5 — Optical: dip, not breakdown.** CIEN beat Q2, fell –15% on priced-in strength. COHR (earnings Aug 12) and LITE (Aug 11) both at analyst buy targets after June pullback; JPMorgan reiterated buys post-SemiAnalysis CPO-delay scare (rebutted by channel checks). InP lead times >40 weeks; CPO penetration ~0.5%, on-track for mass production.

**Sig 6 — Solar: earnings gauntlet.** ENPH reports July 28 (consensus –19.6% YoY, tariff headwind ~3pp GM). FSLR reports July 30 (active securities class action, Aug 24 lead plaintiff deadline). ARRY: 60° tracker + AWM acquisition announced July 22. US module prices steady $0.30/W.

**SK Hynix Q2 earnings (July 28) + MSFT/AMZN/META capex guides (July 29–30)** will either validate or reframe the Morgan Stanley HBM peak thesis. This is the baseline's correction-risk signal tested in real time. AMD Helios with Microsoft as anchor is the week's biggest compute-landscape structural news.
